<h2 id="-unsupervised">🐱 Unsupervised</h2>
<h3 id="diversity-is-all-you-need-learning-skills-without-a-reward-function-diayn">Diversity is All You Need: Learning Skills without a Reward Function (diayn)</h3>
<ul>
<li>ICLR 2019。</li>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/1802.06070" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/1802.06070</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/1802.06070" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/1802.06070</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1802.06070" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1802.06070</a></li>

<li>博客：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/moonout/p/18646972#diversity-is-all-you-need-learning-skills-without-a-reward-function" target="_blank">论文速读纪录 | 2025.01</a></li>
</ul>

<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.03647" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.03647</a></li>
<li>GitHub：<a href="https://github.com/victorcampos7/edl" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/victorcampos7/edl</a></li>
<li>博客：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/moonout/p/19567260#explore-discover-and-learn-unsupervised-discovery-of-state-covering-skills" target="_blank">论文速读记录 | 2026.02</a></li>
</ul>
